commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Here's the change. Oumar Diakite leaves the pitch and Adama Bojang (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
90+4' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jerome Brisard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+1' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Jonas Martin is replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
90+1' The game has come to an end for Bradley Locko. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jordan Amavi (Brest).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
86' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
84' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Teddy Teuma (Reims), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
83' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Adrien Lebeau (Brest) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Adrien Lebeau (Brest).
78' The linesman raises his flag. Oumar Diakite (Reims) is adjudged offside.
76' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
73' A substitution has been made. Jeremy Le Douaron goes off and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on.
73' Lilian Brassier (Brest) sees a yellow card from Jerome Brisard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
71' Excellent touch by Oumar Diakite (Reims)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
68' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Amir Richardson replaces him.
68' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Abdoul Kone and he is replaced by Thomas Foket (Reims).
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Reda Khadra (Reims) for Keito Nakamura.
66' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
65' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
63' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is adjudged offside.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Benjamin Stambouli (Reims). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Mahdi Camara (Brest) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Yehvann Diouf was alert and the score remains the same.
59' Teddy Teuma (Reims) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Marco Bizot to dive and make a save.

59' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Teddy Teuma (Reims) is going to have a crack himself.
58' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Jonas Martin (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
56' Martin Satriano (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Steve Mounie (Brest) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
52' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Reims.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Brest.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) comes onto the pitch so that Amadou Kone can be given a rest.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Lilian Brassier (Brest) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Kenny Lala, and he steers a powerful header from the centre of the box into the middle of the net. 1:1!
45+1' The foul by Abdoul Kone (Reims) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jerome Brisard.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jonas Martin (Brest) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.

45' The game is interrupted. Sergio Akieme (Reims) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Brest in a dangerous position.
43' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Oumar Diakite (Reims) commits a foul after dangerous play. Brest are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
43' Steve Mounie (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
38' Keito Nakamura (Reims) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
37' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

36' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The linesman points to the corner flag, Reims are going to take it.
35' Teddy Teuma (Reims) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
33' Martin Satriano (Brest) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
33' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
31' The game is interrupted now, Marshall Munetsi (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
28' Bradley Locko (Brest) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

25' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Junya Ito showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it into the middle of the net – 0:1.

22' Steve Mounie (Brest) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jerome Brisard blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Reims have a free kick.
19' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul. Reims have a free kick.
16' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
15' Martin Satriano (Brest) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is alert and denies him.

11' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
11' It seemed like Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
9' Amadou Kone (Reims) picks up a yellow card.
9' The game is interrupted as Oumar Diakite (Reims) is flagged offside.
9' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mahdi Camara (Brest) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Reims.
5' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

2' That didn't go as planned! Mahdi Camara (Brest) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Yehvann Diouf, who easily kept it out. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Brest will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jerome Brisard.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
